description: Ten-week internship on a bottling-line retrofit team, moving a 1998 filling line from relay logic to a Siemens S7-1200 with a modern HMI.
highlights: Translated 40 pages of relay ladder schematics into structured TIA Portal blocks, reviewed and commissioned on the live line
Wired and validated the E-stop chain to EN ISO 13850 with the site safety engineer
Wrote the operator changeover checklist that cut format-change downtime from 55 to 35 minutes
